newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish ABB unit issues 50 mln zlotys of CPs.
newsitem.headline: Polish ABB unit issues 50 mln zlotys of CPs.

text.p: A Polish unit of ABB group, ABB-Zamech sp. z o.o., has issued 50 million zlotys of two-month commercial papers (CPs), the unit's head Robert Butzke said on Friday.
"In our opinion, this is the most advantageous form of raising funds on the (Polish) market," Butzke told a news conference. "We will use them for current operations and investment," he added.

The issue of CPs, with yields slightly above 18.2 percent of eight-week treasury bills and maturing on November 29, is managed by Bank Rozwoju Eksportu SA and Investmentbank Austria together with its Polish subsidiary, IB Austria Securities brokerage.
ABB-Poland's chief financial officer Marko Marinko, also present, said if the issue went well, an agreement on a longer-term CP programme would be signed between ABB-Zamech and the banks.
